description: Search ClinVar (NCBI E-utilities) for a gene and return its classified variants — the germline clinical significance with its review status, 0–4 star rating, and conditions; any somatic oncogenicity or clinical-impact classification with its own review status and tumor types; molecular consequences, submission counts, and gnomAD-compatible identifiers (canonical SPDI, rsIDs, and a GRCh38 variant ID for gnomad_get_variant) — turning the variant-level significance gnomAD joins into a gene-panel curation view. Optionally filter by germline clinical_significance (e.g. pathogenic) and a minimum germline star rating. Each call returns one window of up to limit ClinVar records; next_offset continues via offset. min_review_stars, and a clinical_significance term outside the seven that search ClinVar's classification index, are applied after the fetch, so their windows can hold fewer rows than limit and total_found is then a candidate count. A window too large to inline is staged on a DataCanvas table named clinvar_variants, returned as canvas_id and table_name beside an inline preview — call gnomad_dataframe_describe for its columns, then gnomad_dataframe_query to rank or count across the window. Keyless, but honors NCBI_API_KEY for a higher rate limit. Credit: ClinVar, NCBI.

canvas_id.description: canvas_id from a prior call. Each search then writes its window to clinvar_variants on that canvas, replacing the previous table even when the window fits inline; a window with no rows removes it. Omit to stage on a fresh canvas only when the window is too large to inline.

clinical_significance.description: Filter by ClinVar germline classification, case-insensitive, matched as whole words, underscores read as spaces; somatic classifications are never matched. pathogenic (Pathogenic and Likely pathogenic, combined and low-penetrance forms included), likely pathogenic, uncertain significance, vus (Uncertain significance plus VUS-high, VUS-mid, and VUS-low), likely benign, benign (Benign and Likely benign), and conflicting search ClinVar's classification index, so alone their windows hold matching records only. Any other term (e.g. risk factor) narrows a text search.

gene.description: HGNC gene symbol (e.g. PCSK9). ClinVar indexes symbols only, so resolve an Ensembl gene ID to its symbol via ensembl_lookup_gene.

limit.description: ClinVar records to fetch in this window. Default 10; a value above 1,500 is clamped to 1,500, with a notice.

min_review_stars.description: Minimum gold-star rating of the germline classification.

offset.description: Zero-based position of the first ClinVar record in this window; pass next_offset to continue.

name: gnomad_search_clinvar

canvas_id.description: Canvas holding table_name, or the canvas_id supplied; empty when this call used no canvas (the window fit inline with no canvas_id, or the gene was an Ensembl ID and nothing was searched).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_unavailable`: NCBI E-utilities is unreachable, failing, or rate-limiting after retries. `upstream_timeout`: NCBI attempts timed out or the shared 45 s search-and-summary budget expired. `upstream_access`: NCBI E-utilities refused the request (access denied). `invalid_upstream_response`: NCBI E-utilities kept answering with a response that failed validation. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filters.description: Row filters applied to this window.

clinical_significance.description: The clinical_significance filter as applied — quotes dropped, underscores read as spaces, trimmed, lowercased; null when omitted or blank.

min_review_stars.description: The min_review_stars floor; null when omitted.

next_offset.description: offset for the next window; null when this window reaches the end.

notice.description: Guidance on a clamped limit, completeness (the offset that continues the list, or an offset past the end), no-match results, the staged table, gnomAD's ClinVar mapping when it could not fill missing grch38_variant_id values, and which identifier to pass to gnomad_get_variant.

preview.description: The window's rows inline: all of them unless spilled.

canonical_spdi.description: Canonical SPDI of the variant (GRCh38, e.g. NC_000001.11:55039973:G:T); null for multi-allele records, CNVs, and records without one.

clinical_impact_classification.description: Somatic clinical-impact classification, an AMP/ASCO/CAP tier (e.g. Tier I - Strong); null when none.

clinical_impact_conditions.description: Tumor types the clinical-impact classification applies to, semicolon-joined; empty when none.

clinical_impact_last_evaluated.description: Date the clinical-impact classification was last evaluated; null when unknown.

clinical_impact_review_status.description: Review status of the clinical-impact classification; null when none.

clinical_significance.description: Germline classification (e.g. Pathogenic); null when none, as on a somatic-only record.

conditions.description: Conditions the germline classification names, semicolon-joined; empty when none.

gold_stars.description: 0–4 star rating derived from the germline review status; 0 when there is none.

grch38_variant_id.description: chrom-pos-ref-alt ID for gnomad_get_variant on a GRCh38 dataset such as the default gnomad_r4: from the canonical SPDI for SNVs, MNVs, and delins, and from gnomAD's ClinVar mapping for deletions, insertions, and duplications. Most of those indel IDs are absent from gnomAD's callsets, so gnomad_get_variant answers variant_not_found: absence evidence to pair with gnomad_get_coverage. Null for mitochondrial, multi-allele, copy-number, and imprecise structural records, and for records newer than gnomAD's ClinVar release.

last_evaluated.description: Date the germline classification was last evaluated; null when unknown.

obj_type.description: Variant object type (e.g. single nucleotide variant).

oncogenicity_classification.description: Somatic oncogenicity classification (e.g. Likely oncogenic, Oncogenic); null when none.

oncogenicity_conditions.description: Tumor types the oncogenicity classification applies to, semicolon-joined; empty when none.

oncogenicity_last_evaluated.description: Date the oncogenicity classification was last evaluated; null when unknown.

oncogenicity_review_status.description: Review status of the oncogenicity classification; null when none.

protein_change.description: Protein change(s), comma-joined as ClinVar reports them.

review_status.description: Review status of the germline classification; null when none.

rsids.description: dbSNP rsIDs, semicolon-joined; empty when none. One rsID can match several gnomAD variants, so prefer grch38_variant_id.

spilled.description: True when the window was too large to inline, so preview holds its first rows and table_name all of them.

table_name.description: Canvas table this call staged (clinvar_variants), holding this window's rows; empty when this call staged no table.

total.description: Rows in this window that passed the filters, including any beyond the preview.

total_found.description: ClinVar's count of records for the gene and filter terms, across every window.

truncated.description: True when ClinVar records remain past this window; continue with next_offset.

unavailable_ids.description: VariationIDs in this window that ClinVar returned no summary for, so they have no row; empty when none.

title: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server: search clinvar
